coverage_check_questions: Is its visible source form already in an original or indexed kit?
Is an actual host/section/contact view missing?
Are interior arch/roof/floor/wall parts present, not just snapshots?
Are flora/fauna appropriate to this location and distinct from existing species?
Are fragile tiny details readable and separate from structural hosts?
Are proposed interfaces and unknown dimensions explicit?
Does the kit preserve source palette, silhouette and motif?
What remains unresolved for modelling rather than another illustration?
interaction_policy: Use filenames and metadata for inventory. Inspect at most one source image at a time. Generate, save, index and review one sheet before starting the next; do not stream large image loops. Keep originals and superseded files.
